name: Chemin des Allemands
description_md:
The Chemin des Allemands is a waymarked hiking route in France measuring 552.8 km. This hard trail features 9012 m of ascent and 8925 m of descent.

The route requires about 162 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule and belongs to the international waymarked hiking network. Its line matches the official route published by ign_bdtopo. The trail passes within 200 m of Dijon, within 1100 m of Jardin des sciences, and within 1900 m of a Dijon Modern style building.
